steps.content: Exhausted from your travels, you and Christina make your way to the Public Security Bureau. She quickly entrusts three cats to a young officer before guiding you through the clamorous main hall. Without a moment's pause, she thrusts open the door to the sheriff's office.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: What do you mean they've vanished into thin air!? This town's so small you could walk across it in five minutes! You've had the whole squad on this for days and still no sign of these lowlifes? What, did they sprout wings and fly away!? Get back out there and find them!
The sheriff ends the call, his expression clouded with irritation. Evidently, the "High-Profile Antique Heist" remains at a standstill.
Forgoing any unnecessary small talk, Christina cuts to the chase, laying the dossier for the "Cat Café Kitty Kidnapping" squarely on his desk.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: The purloined kitties are safe and sound back at the bureau, but we've hit a snag—our guy Henry's been MIA for at least three days now. No clue why, but he left a breadcrumb: 4 Inkborough Street.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: We think he's in hot water over there. Send a team, ASAP!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: 4 Inkborough Street?

The mention of the address finally captures the sheriff's attention. Yet, as he lifts Henry's file and scans the photograph within, he emits a contemptuous snort, his visage a canvas of undisguised revulsion.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Can't shake that warehouse, can he? He's the one who cried wolf about robbers hiding out there just four days ago. We rolled in, guns blazing, and what did we get? A whole lot of nothing!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Now we've got Henry's angle! It's all coming together! 4 Inkborough Street's gotta be tied to the antique heist. Looks like after striking out with the cops, Henry played the bait, swiping cats to drop breadcrumbs and get us sniffing around...

With the final piece of the puzzle in hand, Christina can't help but slam her fist onto the table in exhilaration. She meticulously unravels her entire chain of deductions, informed by the day's discoveries.
Yet, the sheriff remains stoically unimpressed, his impatience manifesting in multiple glances at his wristwatch.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Look, Christina, hats off for the legwork you've done on cracking this case. I'll get someone to shuttle those cats back to the café, and we can put this one to bed for now.
Christina's eyes go wide, a picture of sheer incredulity.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Put this one to bed!? What about the search? What's gonna happen to Henry?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: I never said we're calling off the search. A deadbeat drifter causing false alarms and breaking and entering? Oh, we'll nab him alright, just not on today's to-do list.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What... You're missing the point. Henry's in danger right now, we've got to move—

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: No, you're missing my point. We've got bigger fish to fry. The top priority for the whole precinct is cracking the antique heist and getting the loot back. We can't afford any distractions. No one's got time for your little sleuthing escapades.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But these two cases aren't at odds! If we save Henry, it could be a game-changer for your case too... Admit it, you just don't buy what I'm selling!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: How can I? Based on your wild theories? You claim he's gone AWOL—anyone come forward to report him missing? You say he's in a tight spot—got any proof? Blood, a weapon, CCTV footage of him being snatched—anything?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Christina, you've been playing the Acting Inspector for some time now. Do we really need a refresher on the ABCs? Our "belief" needs to be built on solid proof.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Ever wonder how this whole mess looks through my eyes?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: A low-level hoodlum with a rap sheet for violence, caught red-handed on camera breaking and entering. Plus, we've got a whole squad that can vouch he cried wolf.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: So, he's skedaddling to dodge the law, tossing out red herrings to throw us off his scent, all to buy himself a little more freedom—this is what I've pieced together from cold, hard facts.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But you've got zilch to prove I'm off base! Plus, I cracked this case with my ace detective sidekick, ${PlayerName}. No way we're wrong!

When Christina belts out these words in defiance, her entire face flushes a deep crimson. Her tone is as decisive as a guillotine's blade, but the sheriff can only respond by wearily pinching the bridge of his nose.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Christina, you really wanna keep butting heads with me? Alright, let's cut to the chase.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Pouring resources into some nobody, especially when we're down to the wire on bigger fish to fry, is a total waste of time.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Look, until we solve this antique heist, the best we can do is put the word out to all the shelters in Eastside. If Henry pops up, they'll hold him. Trust me, guys like him can't last long without a handout. He'll come crawling back.
Christina places both hands on the sheriff's desk, her head bowed. Her face is obscured by the shadows thrown by her hair and hat, leaving her expression a mystery to you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Guys like him? Come on, you don't even know the first thing about him. He swiped that cat to give us a lead, for crying out loud! He's putting his neck on the line for what's right!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: And you're telling me it's a waste of time to go after him? Isn't the whole point of the force to chase justice and keep folks safe? Worst-case scenario, we end up on a fool's errand. But that's a hell of a lot better than having his blood on our hands 'cause we dragged our feet!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Do you know what I consider a complete waste of time?

Christina raises her head once more. In her eyes, tinged with a subtle shade of red, you glimpse a complex tapestry of emotions—pain and restraint, as if haunted by memories, yet also a resolute and unwavering determination.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: My parents' sacrifice back then was a complete waste, a tragedy! And I swear on my life, I won't let history repeat itself, not on my watch!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: You...

Clearly caught off guard by her mention of her parents, the sheriff's face is a mask of surprise. Sensing the tension reaching a boiling point, you quickly intervene, aiming to defuse the standoff between the two.
How about this? I'll go with Christina and we'll do some digging. If we find anything concrete, we'll loop you in with solid proof.
This way, we're not draining police resources, and we're also doing our best to keep Henry safe.
The sheriff's face remains stern, but he knows he has to give you some leeway. With a reluctant sneer, he finally speaks, his voice laced with a cutting edge.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Fine, knock yourselves out. Seems like you, the big-shot MBCC Chief, have time to kill, messing around with this hard-headed young lady.
Christina's face flushes with heightened anger. You quietly take her hand in yours, locking eyes with the sheriff as you prepare to speak.
No, I wouldn't call this messing around. I have faith in her instincts.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...My apologies. You're here to back me up, and all I've done is drag you into this hot mess.
Moments after being practically booted from the sheriff's office, Christina murmurs an apology, her voice tinged with regret. You offer a reassuring smile, attempting to lighten the palpable tension.
No worries. "No good deed goes unpunished," right? That's your line, isn't it? As your trusty sidekick, I knew what I was signing up for.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: To be honest, other than Mr. Dole, it feels like no one at the Public Security Bureau ever took me seriously. They probably think I'm just riding someone's coattails or that I'm a loose cannon.
Frustrated, Christina gave a stone on the road a forceful kick.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: They keep calling me a hothead who's all talk and no action, saying I'm just a naive kid. But isn't chasing justice and keeping this city safe why we signed up to be detectives in the first place?
Her head dropped, weighed down by the gravity of her own words.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Look, I get it. When they're knee-deep in high-profile cases, the heat's on from the media and everyone else. Tempers flare, words fly. I get it.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But come on, since when did justice become exclusive to finding lost treasures for the rich and famous? Helping the average Joe matters just as much. Mr. Dole would back me up on that.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Henry's a lone wolf, no ties, no one to miss him if he vanishes off the face of the Earth. So, if we don't step up, who will?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Maybe, just maybe, it's not the high-rollers and celebs who need us most. Maybe it's the "nobodies" like Henry who really need someone in their corner.

As you absorb her words, a revelation strikes you. This young-appearing Acting Inspector is far more mature and nuanced than you had initially estimated. She's not just filling a role; she embodies it, more so than anyone else you can think of.
Hmm, going after Henry isn't a mistake, and standing up for what's right is a no-brainer. We can't win them all, but sticking to our principles? That's non-negotiable.
Hey, being a "passionate crusader for justice" isn't a bad rap, you know? In a world that's fifty shades of messed up, we need people like you to be the compass. Get what I'm saying?
With a warm smile, you gently pat her shoulder, your touch conveying a world of encouragement and understanding.
I've got your back. Whether it's playing the hero or shouting from the rooftops for justice, you've got this.
Sensing a sudden stillness beside you, you glance back. Christina stands there, rooted to the spot, her eyes locked onto you as if caught in a moment of revelation.
Something on your mind?
With a soft laugh, she quickens her pace to fall back in step with you.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Nah, it's just that Mr. Dole once told me something along those lines.
You've brought up this "Mr. Dole" a lot. He must've made quite an impression on you, huh?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Absolutely! Mr. Dole is a legend in the precinct! Sure, he's got a permanent scowl and zero patience, but he's never belittled me like the others. He's been my rock and cheerleader all along.
So, do we need to ask Mr. Dole for help?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Nah, we're good! I'm not a kid anymore; I can handle things myself. And hey, I've got you as my kickass sidekick now, don't I?
Christina beams as she takes your hand, her spirit and zeal miraculously back in full swing.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Chin up! A top-notch detective never throws in the towel! So what if we're flying solo without backup? You and me, we've got what it takes to crack this case wide open and bring them home!
Yo, what's the game plan with this dude?

Hearing the distant chatter, you and Christina move in unison, your footsteps barely making a sound. You both duck behind a metal shelving unit, its surfaces layered with years of grime, that stands beside the corridor. Through the narrow openings between stacked crates, you steal a surreptitious glance.
In the heart of the warehouse, three imposing figures, unmistakably mercenaries, loom over the trussed-up Henry. His mouth is gagged with a grimy cloth, and he's soiled from head to toe.
The mercenary at the forefront gives Henry an irritable kick, drawing from him a moan of helpless agony.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: Mmph mmph mmph...
Just get rid of him; he knows too much.

Only when an icy voice pierces the air do you become aware of a fifth presence in the room. Emerging from behind the imposing metal shelving that had concealed him, another individual leisurely strides into your line of sight—
The individual who emerges from the shadows is the last person anyone would expect—the affluent business owner who played the role of a hapless victim on the news, lamenting his stolen treasures.

The term "inside job" pops into your head like a lightning bolt. It all makes sense now; the authorities have been chasing their tails for days because he's been controlling the narrative from the start.

Shaking off your initial shock, you pivot toward Christina, planning to remind her to capture evidence for the Public Security Bureau. But she's already on it—she's pulled a tiny camera from her pocket and flashes you an approving thumbs-up.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Ha, you've got it easy, just running your mouth. Let's not forget, we agreed to just help you shift your stuff out of the warehouse, stash it for a bit, make the scene look legit, and then haul it back after the cops clear out from your place.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Now we're stuck cleaning up your mess after dodging that surprise search from the cops... We've been saving your hide more times than I can count.

steps.speaker: Rich Businessman
steps.content: Hey, let's not point fingers, alright? If you guys hadn't been caught red-handed moving stuff that night, we wouldn't be dealing with this headache now.

The rich businessman, a veteran in the cutthroat world of commerce, isn't one to back down. While the head mercenary maintains his smug smile, his two underlings advance a step, their faces stern, ratcheting up the tension in the room.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: So, what you're saying is, we dropped the ball?

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: Mmph mmph mmph!

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Oh? Got something on your mind?
He extends his hand and forcefully removes the gag from Henry's mouth. Coughing to clear his throat, Henry raises his head, his eyes methodically scanning the faces of those assembled.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: Cough, cough... The cops will pick up on the breadcrumbs I've left and come running. You lot won't stand a chance.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Ha! Still playing the knight in shining armor, even when you're knocking on death's door? It's almost cringeworthy. Snap out of it, kid. You've been our guest in this lovely place for three days now. Where's your cavalry?

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Ever heard of "The Boy Who Cried Wolf"? You think they'll come running a second time after a wild goose chase? Or maybe you think you're some VIP they can't afford to lose?

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: You're clueless. You mean to tell me that in that massive security bureau, there's not one person with half a brain?

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Fine, keep playing the waiting game. We'll see if they show up in time to scrape you off the floor.

Irritated by the lack of the expected begging and instead receiving a sharp comeback, the head mercenary darkens his expression. He forcefully jams the gag back into Henry's mouth before pivoting back to the rich businessman.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Look, no need to burn bridges here. Let's meet halfway. We'll help you handle the surprise inspection from the cops as a make-good for our slip-up during the move. But if we're talking life-and-death stuff, that's a whole different ballgame and it's gonna cost you.

steps.speaker: Rich Businessman
steps.content: Alright, what's your price?

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Double or nothing.

steps.speaker: Rich Businessman
steps.content: ...Don't you think that's pushing it?

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: What's the deal? Getting cold feet? You're gonna make a killing from insurance fraud, and you can't even toss us a bone? That's not how you climb the ladder, my friend.

steps.speaker: Rich Businessman
steps.content: Look, if I hadn't lost my shirt in those investments and wasn't desperate for cash, do you think I'd be rolling the dice on insurance fraud? And let's be clear, that payout is just plugging holes, nothing more.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Last chance to change your mind.

The head mercenary lets out a sly laugh as he pulls a gun from his waistband, leveling it at the businessman's temple. The businessman, who was just moments ago full of bravado, goes weak in the knees, his face drenched in a cold sweat.

steps.speaker: Rich Businessman
steps.content: Alright, alright, you've got yourself a deal. Double it is.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Deal sealed. Now, let's get down to your fate. To be frank, we didn't have the time or the patience to chase you down. But hey, you practically begged for this by showing up.

He crouches down, lightly tapping Henry's cheek with the cold steel of the gun barrel. The imminent threat of death hangs heavy in the air, piercing through Henry's once-steadfast composure. He starts to thrash about, his muffled cries echoing the desperation of a creature backed into a corner.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: Mmm! Mmm! Mmm!!!

Just as his finger tightens around the trigger, an unexpected thud reverberates through the room. The detective's casebook, hefty as a brick, sails through the air, unerringly disarming the mercenary.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Christina, Acting Inspector of Eastside's Public Security Bureau. You're all under arrest—fraud and kidnapping, the whole nine yards!

Christina, clutching her cane, strides purposefully toward the assembled group. As they get a good look at her, their faces become a tableau of mixed emotions—the businessman exhales a sigh of relief, Henry's face is a mask of residual terror, while the mercenaries erupt into raucous laughter.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Sent a rookie chick to handle this, huh? The Public Security Bureau must be scraping the bottom of the barrel.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ha, who's looking down on whom? You're just bit players in this drama, so watch closely to see who's really going down!

Capitalizing on the moment when the mercenaries are preoccupied with Christina, you covertly snatch up her detective dossier and use it to knock out the businessman attempting to flee amidst the chaos. Swiftly untying Henry, the two of you haul the businessman behind a large metal crate that can serve as makeshift cover.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: Are you guys really the cops?
Yeah, we got the leads you left. Good job. Backup from the precinct is en route. Here, take this communicator and keep them updated, we are counting on you.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: Will do.
Just as Henry grabs the walkie-talkie you pass him, Christina's voice cuts in right on cue.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hey, Sidekick! Where ya at? Time to kick some butt and have some fun
I'm here.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Let's roll! The dynamic duo, unstoppable and undefeated!
She twirls her staff and lunges into the fray, as you, standing behind her, slowly lift your hand.
Empowered by your shackles, Christina's combat prowess escalates. Incoming bullets are either deflected by your shackles or parried by her staff, scattering metallically across the floor.
The three mercenaries soon find themselves backed into a corner, their faces etched with defeat. With nowhere else to go, they aim their firearms, ready for a desperate last stand.

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Damn it! These two are Sinners!

steps.speaker: Junior Mercenary
steps.content: What's the plan, boss? I'm almost outta bullets here...

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: Ugh, fine. Bring out the big gun.
The three lock eyes for a split second, each unholstering a spherical device from their belts and launching it in your direction.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Watch out—
Christina reflexively brandishes her staff, inadvertently setting off the trio of compact gas grenades. With a resounding pop, a suffocating cloud of white smoke engulfs the room in an instant.
You both find yourselves coughing and tearing up, hurriedly pulling up your sleeves to shield your mouth and nose.

As the white haze finally starts to dissipate, the corner you were focusing on is eerily vacant. The only trace left is the receding sound of chaotic footsteps echoing from behind you. You whirl around in haste, but only manage to spot the tail end of a garment vanishing behind a row of shelves.
They're heading for the depot entrance! They're trying to escape!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Damn it... We can't let them get away!
You bolt after them, chasing the fading sound of their footsteps. But before you can close the gap, the footsteps ahead come to an abrupt halt, supplanted by a string of exasperated expletives.

Rounding the bend, you catch sight of Henry at the warehouse entrance. He's aiming his comm device at three mercenaries, their faces etched with hopelessness. Looming behind him is a sea of heavily-armed law enforcement officers.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: It's over.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: I told you, there's no running from this..

steps.speaker: Head Mercenary
steps.content: They're using freaking special power on us regular folks! How's that fair?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Told ya, looks can be deceiving. Who's laughing now?

steps.speaker: Policeman
steps.content: Shut up! Keep moving!
In this moment, Christina sits beside you on the large metal crate, her mood noticeably lifted as she watches her timely-arrived colleagues take care of the cleanup and aftermath.
Her face is a canvas of grime and perspiration, marred by a few minor scrapes. Despite this, her eyes are ablaze with an unmistakable gleam.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: You, snap some pics and jot down the details. You, make another trip to that scam's place and dig up the stashed goods. You, go round up that stick-up guy... yeah, and the hostage, cuff them both.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What the heck!? Hold your horses! We cracked this case wide open because of Henry's breadcrumbs. He's the real MVP!
With a furrowed brow, Christina leaps down from her perch beside you and makes a beeline for the sheriff, intercepting him in his tracks.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Christina, look, I get you have a soft spot for the guy, but he's still a burglar, plain and simple. We gotta play it by the book; that's our job. If we start bending the rules based on what feels right, then what are we even doing here?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: But...

Christina realizes she can't refute the sheriff's argument, but she's still determined to fight for whatever leniency she can get for Henry. To her surprise, Henry, who has been quietly standing behind her, beats her to the punch.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: It's all good.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: A couple of years behind bars? I can take it. Don't sweat it on my account. I got what I came for, so it's a win-win.
The metallic clink of the silver handcuffs locking around Henry's wrists cuts through the air, almost grating in its clarity. Yet, his face reveals a smile, as if a weight has been lifted.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: You know, I've always had a soft spot for cats and whodunits. Growing up, I fancied myself becoming some sort of Sherlock Holmes—cracking cases wide open, nabbing the villains, and being a beacon of justice.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: But you know, reality hit me hard as I got older. Anyone who heard about my little detective fantasy just chuckled. To them, I was just a lost cause—no skills, but too stubborn to settle for less.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: But today, I showed them. I'm not just some pie-in-the-sky dreamer. Standing up for what's right actually counts for something, and I can make a real difference... So cheers, for making my justice fantasy come true, even if it's just this once.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: I guess my ship has sailed, but you—you've got a real shot at becoming one hell of a detective.

steps.speaker: Henry
steps.content: ..Alright then. Time to move.
Henry strides away, handcuffs and all, without a backward glance.
Christina watches his retreating form, stands tall, clenches her fist, and offers a solemn, by-the-book salute.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Henry did what he had to do for the greater good, and almost paid the ultimate price. No one fighting for justice should have to face such an outcome.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Why did it come to this? I've given it everything I've got, done all I could, and still, I couldn't get him the justice he deserves.

You've done more than anyone could've asked for. If it weren't for you, the truth would've stayed buried, the bad guys would still be roaming free, and Henry would've been another misunderstood casualty.
And... who's to say this is the final chapter?
Christina turns to look at you.
There's still a chance to make things right; we might just be able to clear Henry's name.

steps.speaker: [Image] Maze outside the Ring
steps.content: Hey, sidekick!
On this fine morning, Christina makes a spirited entrance into your office, her eyes twinkling and her brows lifted in unmistakable delight.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah, there you are! Perfect timing! I've got some fantastic news—Henry's been let go by the Public Security Bureau!
Eager to share the news, she slides a document across your desk. Alongside Henry's personal details, a bold headline catches your eye—"Security Bureau's Undercover Snitch Protection Initiative."

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Sure, Henry broke into a place, but he also cracked open a big case for us. So, it's like he's made amends, you know?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: And get this, the guy's sharp as a tack and super into solving mysteries. I pulled some strings and got him into this "Undercover Snitch" program. So, he's gone from lawbreaker to my inside man!
Caught up in her infectious excitement, a heartfelt smile spreads across your face.
You really did it!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You betcha! Who am I, you ask? I'm the fearless, detail-oriented, and brilliant numero uno detective of Eastside! Good still triumphs in this world, and what goes around comes around

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ah, almost slipped my mind—got another piece of good news, and it's got your name on it!
Me?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Yes, recall our chat in the interrogation room? I told you, "You're on probation till you prove your worth." Well, hats off to you, you've aced the test and now you're my right-hand man—officially!
Well, to gain the endorsement of such a renowned detective is a genuine privilege.
Unable to contain your grin, she inhales deeply, locking eyes with you in a moment of gravity, as though she's reached a pivotal decision.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Look, we've been through hell and high water together, so it's time to drop the act. Sidekick, I've got to level with you—I'm knee-deep in a case that's as dark as they come, and it's all about "that person"...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I'll tell you everything, I promise. But first, I need a sec to get my head and heart in the right place. Can you... hang tight for me?
Your own grin dissolves, replaced by an expression of earnest gravity as you reply.
Of course, I can wait as long as you need. Your dear sidekick will always stand by the detective's side.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Awesome! It's a pact, then! But for the moment, let's roll up our sleeves and tackle some other urgent stuff—
...Huh?

Caught off guard by her whirlwind shift in topics, you can only watch in bewilderment as she conjures up an imposing stack of case files, seemingly out of thin air, and unceremoniously dumps them onto your desk.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: From high-profile mysteries to the small-time gigs, we've got to juggle it all. It's all part of the detective's toolkit for being top-notch.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Voila! Up next, we've got some long-forgotten cold cases that have been sitting in the archives, just begging to be solved. With our dynamic duo powers, we're bound to crack them open.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hey, the world's still chock-full of bad guys waiting for a taste of justice! The adventures of Eastside's finest detective and her right-hand assistant are far from over!
